column1: # #1006 shared hand oracle: the Parsed root a predicate child returned, at the low-level Classic entry.
# Input "😀\r\nc"; the prefix "😀\r\n" (3 code points) is consumed first, then scope(predicate(shape)) runs
# with the token kind of the row. Java contract: a MatchOnly token returns its own source; Choice and a
# generated rule's LazyChoice return the selected child's Parsed; Chain, Optional and LazyChain collect
# the tokens of the current kind, and a virtual collector that keeps none returns generated "".
# A success that returned no token (PEG assertion) is the cursor span. Generated text (gen:g, gen:
# returned at host anchor 0) never reaches the callback and fails at the child's start.
# MO = MatchOnly('c'); LA = UBNF LOOKAHEAD('c'); &c / !z = PEG assertions; Empty = Java EmptyParser;
# Opt = Java Optional; Rule[...] = a generated rule class. candidate is text@start (~ is ""), - for none.
